title: •Imperial Tyranny
caption: •Imperial Tyranny (V)
game_text: USED: ▼ Empire’s New Order. OR If Vader just won a battle at the same site as an alien, place that alien out of play. LOST: If a battle was just initiated where you have a character weapon card, place the top card of your Lost Pile on top of Reserve Deck.
lore: The Empire considers alien species to be inferior.

notes: Unique. Printed base is a Lost Interrupt; slip banner reads USED OR LOST INTERRUPT. The slip runs USED: … LOST: … as one paragraph (no line break before LOST:), kept as printed. Slip heading prints a double space '•Imperial Tyranny  (V)'; the bottom strip has a single space (caption). ▼ where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; curly apostrophe in Empire’s. Lore matches the scan. Base scan only at 350 px. Copyright line not legible on the 350 px scan; set-convention form. Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3 -pre, 350 px).
